notes.title: NEW VR Sports Golf DLC Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Grip it and rip it with the new DLC, VR Sports - Golf! [/h1]
Get your daily dose of iron here and wash it down with a nice refreshing Arnold Palmer.  With VR Sports - Golf, you feel as if you're on the fairway yet don't have to worry about chasing the golf ball(s) into the woods.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049192/a24c0328660dcabb2d6fed411828dee86620650c.jpg[/img]
Sure, you're inside wearing a VR headset and not in Augusta, but until you get your green jacket, this will have to do. 

[h1]Don't miss 10% discount for launch week[/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/647370/VR_Sports__Golf/

notes.title: NEW VR Sports Table Tennis DLC Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h1]We brought in a professional Table Tennis coach from the Japanese Athletic Association to ensure the most authentic Table Tennis experience in gaming.[/h1]

Get your paddles ready!  We are adding a NINTH sport to already the most authentic virtual reality sports game on the market.  Available for 10% at launch!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049192/74dbf5d1fce2e67bc7fd012668b512eba317c6c3.jpg[/img]

But remember, if you are looking for a soft serve, go to Dairy Queen.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/647371/VR_Sports__Table_Tennis/

notes.title: NEW SPORT!! "Kart" comes to VR Sports as a free add-on, today!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049192/169c4acbe5fb0a73c19a55ed3adf03cf1b75b2e4.png[/img]

*User-controlled steering, braking, and acceleration gives an authentic go-kart feel
*Race against the CPU
*Leaderboards
*Test your actual racing skills on multiple-turn tracks
*3 difficulty levels

*WARNING* - If you are prone to motion sickness, there is a chance that this sport will affect you.  Please be aware of this before playing "Kart"
